contract_note: Descriptive inventory for people and agents; not an executable job queue or an automatically validated schema. No asset files have been produced or runtime checks performed.
ui_owned_by_code: Plant names, individual IDs, taxonomy, origin and uncertainty labels
Location and note fields, labels and validation
Edit, save, cancel and recovery controls
Surfaces, separators, focus and state feedback
Empty, no-results, missing-image and image-error text

assets.purpose: Optional supporting photo of the actual individual plant after the primary data on detail; not required for list recognition or editing

used_by.region: Read state, after primary plant data

source.provenance_note: No real photo is supplied for hypothetical fixtures PLT-014 or PLT-027. Any future source must identify the actual individual, source and allowed use; retain the original and its mapping to the record.
allowed_changes: Documented orientation, crop and resizing that preserve identifying information and factual color
prohibited_changes: Inventing plant features or changing factual coloration to match a palette

display.appearance_note: Preserve the same factual photo across appearances; review surrounding UI, contrast and crop in the implemented target.
display.fallback: Show Chưa có ảnh cá thể when absent, or Không đọc được ảnh cá thể when unreadable; retain identity, record content and read/edit/save actions. Do not add a photo-upload action in this slice.

assets.purpose: Optional decorative illustration for the collection-empty state; carries no specimen or provenance information

used_by.region: Collection-empty state only; deferred and not integrated

source.provenance_note: No reference, prompt, generation call or output exists. Route is a possible future production choice, not authorization or execution. Artwork must remain visibly illustrative and unrelated to an individual record.

display.fallback: Use the complete UI-owned Chưa có cây nào empty-state text. No decorative asset or fake add-plant button is needed.

assets.purpose: Consistent system glyph family for applicable navigation, search and record actions, paired with UI-owned labels and semantics

source.provenance_note: Prefer system-provided controls and SF Symbols appropriate to the chosen build target. Exact glyph names, availability and code mapping have not been selected or verified.

display.appearance_note: Use platform/control styling and semantic colors; verify real sizes, appearances, disabled states and accessibility behavior.
display.fallback: Use a clear text-labeled native control or verified available symbol. Do not export replacement raster icons or make actions depend on an unavailable glyph.
